description: MOSAIC's phase state of every size bin as EqWeFiC states it (components/aerosol/mosaic; the residuals are in the .esm files and the iterations are the integrator's, D95): two solves in sequence. Kelvin.aw is the bin water activity, the scalar root of Kelvin's constraint 0 ~ aw0/K(aw) - aw (couplings/mosaic_kelvin_equilibrium.esm). Mesa.e_salt is the solid amount of each of the fifteen soluble salts, the unknown of MESA's constraint 0 ~ g with g = S - 1 (couplings/mosaic_mesa_equilibrium.esm), bounded in the model by lb 0, which makes it the complementarity problem e_salt >= 0, g <= 0, e_salt g = 0. Each residual pairs with its unknown by the diagonal structural pairing (D120). The component names are EqWeFiC's; the model joining the two documents is the assembly EqWeFiC has not written yet (on MESA's branch the Kelvin and MESA solves nest or are solved together, which is the assembly's choice), so this fixture is checked against the schema only.
